structure.source: Two conferences of four 4-team divisions, in the real league's alignment. Conference names are placeholders until the Phase 6 naming session.

roster.source: 2025 season roster rules as reported by NBC Sports (Aug 2025): 90 in the offseason, 53 from cutdown day on, 48 active on game day, practice squad of 16 plus one International Player Pathway slot. Enforced from Phase 8; re-check against the CBA then.

draft.source: Seven rounds; teams hold their picks for the current draft and the next two. Verify trading-window rules in Phase 8.

calendar.source: Week 1 of the 2026 season starts Thursday Sept 10 (the league opened Wed Sept 9); other seasons start the Thursday after Labor Day. Playoff rounds are a week apart with an open week before the championship, which puts the 2025 championship on Feb 8, 2026, as in reality. Preseason dates are stubs.

schedule.source: NFL scheduling formula (operations.nfl.com, 2021 17-game announcement). Rotation tables: index 0 is the 2026 season, read from NFL.com's 2026 opponent lists; the other years follow the 3-year (same conference) and 4-year (other conference) cycles. Each other-conference pair is [Conference A division, Conference B division]. The 17th game pairs same-place finishers using the other-conference pairing from two seasons earlier; Conference B hosts it in even years (NFC hosts in 2026). Byes in Weeks 5-14 with at most 6 teams off per week (2025 schedule); Week 18 all division games; trade deadline after Week 9 (2025 deadline Nov 4).

playoffs.source: Seven clubs per conference (four division winners seeded 1-4, three wild cards 5-7); the top seed has a bye; 2v7, 3v6, 4v5; reseeded after the wild-card round so the top seed hosts the lowest remaining seed; higher seed hosts; neutral-site championship.
